description: Co-president of the SP/PS alongside Mattea Meyer, elected on 17 October 2020 succeeding Christian Levrat; the duo received about 96% of delegates' votes.

National Councillor for the canton of Aargau, in office since December 2011. Member of the Finance Committee (FK-N) and the Economic Affairs and Taxation Committee (WAK-N); previously sat on the State Politics and Business Audit committees.
President of the JUSO; previously the organisation's central secretary from 2005.
Served on the Baden Residents' Council.
Worked in development cooperation for the labour-aligned NGO Solidar Suisse; also worked as a personal assistant to Aargau politician Urs Hofmann during this period.
Reported to consult for Spinas Civil Voices, a Zurich communications/civil-society agency.
